tagline: A European market in Melbourne's south east

departments.name: Fruit & Veg
departments.blurb: Market-fresh produce every day at wholesome market prices.
departments.intro: Fresh fruit and vegetables arrive every day. Seasonal European staples sit next to the everyday basics: tomatoes, capsicums, leafy greens, citrus, stone fruit in summer, and the herbs the deli and café cook with.

departments.name: Deli & Cheese
departments.blurb: Continental smallgoods, cured meats and a cheese cabinet worth the drive.
departments.intro: Our deli counter is the heart of the store: leg ham, prosciutto, salami and sopressa sliced to order, olives and antipasto, and a cheese cabinet that runs from Gruyère and pecorino to halloumi, saganaki and fresh mascarpone.

departments.name: Butcher
departments.blurb: In-house butchers, premium cuts and traditional chevapi.
departments.intro: Our in-house butcher team cuts to order. Steaks, roasts, chicken, lamb, house-made chevapi and sausages, with advice on what to cook and how.

departments.name: Seafood
departments.blurb: Fresh seafood specials every week, oysters by the dozen.
departments.intro: Fresh seafood lands through the week: Tasmanian oysters, prawns, salmon, local mussels and whole fish. Thursday is the day to come in for the widest choice.

departments.name: Fresh Pasta & Ready Meals
departments.blurb: Handmade pasta and gnocchi, sauces and ready-made meals.
departments.intro: Fresh pasta and gnocchi are handmade in the market, from the first mix to the final cut. Take home our ready-made sauces, lasagne and pizzas, or eat them at the café's gnocchi bar.

departments.name: Bakery & Pastry
departments.intro: Pistachio croissants, cannoli, crostoli, panettone in season and fresh bread, alongside the imported biscuits and sweets everyone comes back for.

departments.name: Grocery & Imports
departments.blurb: Italian, Greek and European pantry staples, imported direct.
departments.intro: Pasta, passata, olive oil, coffee, rice, beans, honey and the brands you grew up with: La Molisana, Mutti, Rummo, Kimbo, Lavazza, Illy, Colavita and more.

departments.name: Liquor
departments.blurb: Italian wines, liqueurs and more, in store.
departments.intro: A considered range of Italian and European wine, Lambrusco, Chianti, Pinot Grigio, Amaretto, Limoncino and Frangelico. Available in store only.

cafe.name: Market Europa Café
cafe.intro: Breakfast, panini, handmade gnocchi from Antonio's fresh gnocchi bar, and proper coffee. Order and pay at the front counter; no bookings needed.
